newsitem.title: USA: Mako Marine sale to Tracker postponed.
newsitem.headline: Mako Marine sale to Tracker postponed.

text.p: Mako Marine International Inc said Friday the sale of a controlling stake in Mako to Tracker Marine LP has been postponed because of Mako's inability to fulfill certain material conditions.
Mako did not provide details but said it might face a "substantial question" on continuing as a going concern if it did not reach a resolution with Tracker by January 31.
The companies had expected the transaction to close on December 31.
Mako officials were not immediately available for comment.

Mako also said that effective today, its common shares and common stock warrants will be listed on the OTC Bulletin Board under the symbols MAKO and MAKOW, respectively, instead of on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The company's shares closed Thursday at three.
Tracker is a Springfield, Mo.-based maker of freshwater fishing and pontoon boats. Mako is a Miami-based boatmaker.

The companies agreed in December for Tracker to buy 6.4 million new Mako shares -- about 80 percent of the company -- for $4.14 million in cash and the contribution of certain assets relating to Tracker's saltwater boat division.
